body: Use case stylized-concept. Production transparent 2D fantasy CHARACTER CUTOUT atlas. Arcane Vanguard clean cel-shaded painted fantasy, dark contours, restrained material detail. Iron Clan Dwarf Gunner: stocky short dwarf with thick orange beard, iron helmet with tiny brass spike, warm brown leather armored tunic, brass cartridge belt, grey iron bracers, dark trousers, heavy brown boots, small leather back mantle. Blunderbuss is separate, no gun on the body. Exact portrait1024x1536 layout: SIXcolumns TWELVErows. Every column is a different true facing: E,rightprofile; SE,frontright; SW,frontLEFT; W,leftprofile; NW,rearleft; NE,rearRIGHT with back of head visible. 72 SEPARATE parts. Rows top to bottom HEAD, torso without head or arms, rear mantle/cape, pelvis/belt, left upperarm, right upperarm, left forearm withhand, right forearm withhand, leftleg withoutboot, rightleg withoutboot, leftboot, rightboot. Neutral straight parts. Generous empty gap between all pieces; heads MUST NOT touch torsos, no limbs attached to torsos. No assembled character, weapons, text, labels, grid, scenery, background or shadows. Truly alpha-transparent background.
equipment: Use case stylized-concept. Production transparent 2D fantasy Iron Clan equipment cutouts, clean celshaded painted art with crisp contours, brass/iron/wood materials. ONE ROW six separate dwarf blunderbusses with brass flared muzzle, dark steel barrel, wooden stock, side trigger. All gun barrels POINT STRAIGHT UP and stocks DOWN, six subtly different rotated views E,SE,SW,W,NW,NE. No hands. Six isolated guns, generous space. Landscape1536x1024, exactequalcolumns, alpha-zero gaps, no background, no shadows, no labels, no frames.
